resources.string: Meet the menus that changed in the latest version.
The mode menu is now Select, Draw, Add, Edit. Rotate, Scale and Crop live under Edit.
The old \"Brush settings\" is now \"Properties\": it shows the selected tool\'s settings. It fills in for the brush, eraser, pen or text tool.
Move and Expand are two separate buttons under Edit. Move works when an element is selected, Expand when the canvas is selected.
In simple mode on a portrait screen there are three menus: Add, Draw, Select & edit. Each menu is one row; if it doesn\'t fit it scrolls sideways.
The tools were reordered: Pen, Eraser, Paint, Shapes, Challenge, Stencil and Text come first.
Drawing challenges are among the first tools. Adding 3D shapes was removed from kids mode.
